aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Prioritizes evidence-backed claims and provenance for externally sourced facts.

aspects.name: ClarificationFocused
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions needed to move forward.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Checks required fields, re-checks constraints during revision, and avoids finalizing when critical information is missing.

aspects.name: AssumptionDisciplined
aspects.text: Records unresolved items in a short assumptions log and distinguishes assumption-bearing drafts.

concepts.definition: Internal company newsletter communications intended for employees or internal stakeholders.
Internal communications that notify the organization about updates, events, or decisions.
Condensed summaries of recent updates gathered into a single communication.
Concise, high-level summaries prepared for executives.
Materials produced as part of internal communications work, such as newsletters, announcements, or briefs.
A collection of sources or supporting evidence used to justify the draft communication.
Traceability showing where externally sourced facts came from.
Authorized procedures or patterns for retrieving information from sources.
Accepted formats or containers for normalized evidence returned from delegated subtasks.
